Event Description:

The Online Session on “VTools Training, IEEE Funding & Benefits” organized by the IEEE Hyderabad Section aims to empower student members and volunteers with essential knowledge about IEEE operational tools and opportunities.

The session will provide hands-on guidance on using IEEE vTools for event management, reporting, and activity tracking. It will also cover various IEEE funding opportunities, including how to apply for rebates, grants, and financial support for student branch activities.

Additionally, participants will gain insights into the wide range of IEEE membership benefits, helping them maximize their professional growth, networking, and leadership opportunities within IEEE.

This session is highly beneficial for Student Branch leaders, volunteers, and members who wish to effectively utilize IEEE resources and enhance the impact of their activities.
